neumann_bc_xmin.description: Neumann ghost-cell prescription at xmin for cell-centered uniform Cartesian grids (ESS §9.2 / §9.4). The `value` is the outward normal derivative du/dn at xmin; since the outward normal at xmin points in the -x direction, du/dn = -du/dx. Using a centered-difference approximation across the boundary face: (u[0] - u_ghost) / dx = -value, giving u_ghost = u[0] + dx * value. Pattern matches the synthetic `bc` node (§9.2); `kind` and `side` fields are spec-compliant annotations — ESS pattern matching on these fields is pending. `produces` declares the ghost variable per §9.4 (not yet processed by the current rule engine; documented for forward compatibility). Analytic check: (u[0] - u_ghost) / dx = (u[0] - (u[0] + dx*value)) / dx = -value = du/dn at xmin.
